summary: A Yes vote updates the City of Emeryville's business license tax with rates up to 0.4% of gross receipts, raising about $12.4 million annually for general city services until ended by voters.

tax.text: A Yes vote would approve a business-tax increase expected to raise additional revenue for city programs and services.
tax.quote: The tax revenue would be put in the city's general fund and could be spent on programs and services that benefit public safety, seniors and youth, road repair and parks, among other things.
